window_policy: Latest 200 complete newline-terminated decisions at capture, declared before reading outcomes; all rows retained.
source_record_hash_convention: SHA256 of the exact source line including its newline
source_binding: Scalar journal projection only; installed loop, adapter, candidate pools, revealed-history population and normalization remain unjoined. Raw prefix and source location retained with custody receipt outside the paper tree.
transformations: One row per logged admission decision. Retained utility is the logged post-decision value, not a cumulative maximum; no smoothing, resampling, clipping or outcome selection.
